title: Baked Oat and Mushroom Loaf with Peas
blurb: A hearty vegetarian loaf combining oats, mushrooms and peas with herbs, baked until firm and golden.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and line a loaf tin with baking paper.
Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat and cook the onion for five minutes until softened.
Add the mushrooms and garlic to the pan and cook for eight minutes until the mushrooms release their liquid and it evaporates.
Stir the frozen peas and thyme into the mushroom mixture and cook for two minutes, then remove from the heat.
In a large bowl, beat the eggs and mix in the oats, grated cheddar, salt and pepper.
Add the mushroom and pea mixture to the bowl and stir everything together until well combined.
Spoon the mixture into the prepared loaf tin, press down firmly and smooth the top.
Bake for 60 minutes until the loaf is firm and golden on top, then leave to cool in the tin for ten minutes before slicing.
